title: Mahmoud Gamal, MarCom business partner for Schneider Electric
desc: MarCom Business Partner · Content Strategy & BTL Activations
statement: Delivering integrated marketing campaigns, content strategy, and data-driven customer experiences aligned with business objectives.
fit_intro: Here is how my hands-on background in activation management, digital strategy, and analytics aligns with Schneider Electric requirements, along with honest partial matches.
fit: Kept up 10–12 campaign activations per month by coordinating creative teams and media buyers with full brand governance.
Aligned creative briefs, media spend, and CRM lead intake to drive 700 qualified leads in a single month across 4 campaigns.
Turned GA4 and Looker Studio performance data into creative briefs and optimization recommendations that produced a 1.45% average Meta CTR.
Authored over 190 SEO articles and produced multi-platform video content generating 470K+ plays in one month.
Coordinated contractors, site teams, and military stakeholders on infrastructure projects during engineering service, and align sales with marketing today.

letter: My professional journey combines civil engineering precision, hands-on real-estate sales, and multi-channel digital marketing. Having managed physical infrastructure sites as well as large-scale digital campaigns, I understand how to bridge technical domain knowledge with clear customer communications.

At The Address Investments, I coordinated 10–12 campaign activations per month and managed briefs across an EGP 10M/month ad budget. By translating GA4 and Looker Studio insights into targeted content and aligning media spend with CRM lead intake, I generated 700 qualified leads in a single month and delivered a 1.45% average Meta CTR.

Schneider Electric's focus on turning sustainability ambitions into action through automation, electrification, and digitization resonates with my engineering foundation and automated marketing workflows. I admire your commitment to impactful customer experiences and inclusive corporate values.

In this MarCom Business Partner role, I aim to combine brand management, BTL activations, and data analytics to design cohesive customer journeys across Saudi Arabia and support Schneider Electric's growth.
role: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist, The Address Investments
